description: This header file defines the WifiChannel class within the beerocks namespace, representing a Wi-Fi channel with attributes like channel number, center frequency, bandwidth, frequency type, and related properties. It includes constructors, getters, setters, and utility methods to manage Wi-Fi channel details.

classes.name: WifiChannel
classes.description: Represents a Wi-Fi channel with properties such as channel number, center frequency, bandwidth, and additional parameters to describe Wi-Fi channels in various frequency bands.

methods.name: WifiChannel
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes an empty WifiChannel.

methods.name: WifiChannel(uint8_t channel, uint16_t center_frequency, eWiFiBandwidth bandwidth, bool m_ext_above_secondary)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with primary channel, center frequency, bandwidth, and extension above secondary flag.

methods.name: WifiChannel(uint8_t channel, eFreqType freq_type, eWiFiBandwidth bandwidth, bool m_ext_above_secondary)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with channel, frequency type, bandwidth, and extension above secondary flag.

methods.name: WifiChannel(const WifiChannel &wc)
methods.description: Copy constructor.

methods.name: operator=(const WifiChannel &wc)
methods.description: Assignment operator.

methods.name: get_channel
methods.description: Returns the primary channel number.

methods.name: set_channel
methods.description: Sets a new primary channel, updates center frequency accordingly.

methods.name: get_center_frequency
methods.description: Returns the center frequency.

methods.name: get_center_frequency_2
methods.description: Returns the center frequency for 160MHz bandwidth on 6GHz band, or 0 if not applicable.

methods.name: get_bandwidth
methods.description: Returns the bandwidth.

methods.name: set_bandwidth
methods.description: Sets the bandwidth, updates center frequency accordingly.

methods.name: get_freq_type
methods.description: Returns the frequency type (2.4GHz, 5GHz, 6GHz).

methods.name: get_ext_above_primary
methods.description: Returns the extension above primary indicator (1, 0, -1).

methods.name: get_ext_above_secondary
methods.description: Returns true if the secondary channel is above the primary.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the object is default-initialized (empty).

methods.name: is_dfs_channel
methods.description: Checks if the channel is a DFS (Dynamic Frequency Selection) channel.

methods.name: get_tx_power
methods.description: Returns the transmit power value.

methods.name: set_tx_power
methods.description: Sets the transmit power.

methods.name: get_radar_affected
methods.description: Returns whether the channel is affected by radar.

methods.name: set_radar_affected
methods.description: Sets whether the channel is radar affected.
